items.title: 日本秋田特色便当引热议：150日元鲑鱼饭 鲑鱼仅5g
items.summary: 近日，日本秋田县一款当地特色便当“牡丹红鲑鱼饭”在社交网络走红，却因食材分量引发大量网友讨论。盒内米饭上只放置一块鲑鱼，尺…

content.v: 近日，日本秋田县一款当地特色便当“牡丹红鲑鱼饭”在社交网络走红，却因食材分量引发大量网友讨论。这款便当售价仅150日元，约合人民币6.3元，价格非常便宜。但是盒内米饭上只放置一块鲑鱼，尺寸长约2厘米，重量仅5克，照片流传到网络后，不少网友吐槽鲑鱼分量过于迷你。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141059174198.jpg
据售卖该便当的店家介绍，便当使用的是秋田特色盐渍红鲑（ぼだっこ），特点是盐分极高，风味浓郁，主打“超咸下饭”。店家解释，这种鲑鱼咸度远超普通鲑鱼，若是放多了会过咸无法入口，目前2厘米的大小刚好适配一盒米饭，是当地传统吃法。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141106486696.jpg
尽管网上争议不断，这款平价便当的线下销路十分稳定。店家表示，牡丹红鲑鱼饭每日可售出约100份，在当地拥有不少忠实食客。不少本地人表示，这并非商家“偷工减料”，而是传统的食用方式，一小块重盐鲑鱼，用来搭配大量白米饭提味。
有外地网友初见图片直呼“鱼比米粒大不了多少”，难以理解；了解秋田饮食文化的食客则称，这是当地传承已久的灵魂美食，核心是借咸香鲑鱼激发米饭风味，而非大口吃鱼。还有网友专门品尝后表示，米饭根本不够，鲑鱼还剩下了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141059176657.jpg

items.title: 游戏明明能随便作恶 为什么9成玩家最后都选择当好人？
items.summary: 如今不少高自由度RPG游戏，都会给玩家提供作恶选项，随便击杀NPC、选择反派路线都能实现。但有意思的是，大量玩家最后并不会选择当坏人，反而老老实实选择做游戏里的大善人，这个话题在网上引发大量讨论。网上流传一组游戏数据很有

content.v: 如今不少高自由度RPG游戏，都会给玩家提供作恶选项，随便击杀NPC、选择反派路线都能实现。
但有意思的是，大量玩家最后并不会选择当坏人，反而老老实实选择做游戏里的大善人，这个话题在网上引发大量讨论。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791947307_818305_png_r.webp
网上流传一组游戏数据很有趣，星露谷物语里面，95%玩家都会选择修复社区中心，也就是走好人路线，不去搞破坏。
很多玩家原本以为，现实里要守各种规矩，到游戏里就能随心所欲做恶人，可实际体验下来，大家反而更愿意在虚拟世界里肆无忌惮做好人。
在自由度很高的RPG里面，做好人的游戏体验反而更舒服。如果遇到NPC欺骗自己，玩家大不了将之处决，不用像现实里面一样吃哑巴亏。
好人路线可以收获伙伴陪伴，拥有完整的支线剧情，要是一路作恶，身边的NPC都会远离你，最后只剩自己孤身一人，陪伴感会大打折扣。
就算游戏没有明确划分善恶路线，玩家也会主动思考选择。就像《上古卷轴5》，大量玩家会认真对比帝国和风暴斗篷双方的理念，分析不同选择对整个天际世界带来的影响，仔细挑选更合理的一方，不是单纯想靠破坏找刺激。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791947330_584322.png
《博德之门3》玩家社区也能看出这种倾向，大家讨论的重点，不是善恶路线谁给的装备奖励更多，而是想尽办法保住更多角色的性命，甚至寻找BUG救下剧情设定里必死的人物。
当然，这不是说玩家完全不会做坏事。大部分人可以接受小偷小摸这类小恶，但是无差别屠杀、纯粹的恶意伤害，很少有人愿意去做。
说到底，大家玩游戏，更多是来体验故事、收获陪伴，而不是单纯发泄恶意。在虚拟世界当好人，不用承担现实里的代价，还能收获更好的剧情体验，这也是大部分玩家的共同选择。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: Steam 现在有一个令人发狂的弹跳徽标屏幕保护程序，我很确定它并没有完全击中角落
items.summary: It sucks, get rid of it.

content.v: The Steam client got a major new update today, with Big Picture Mode receiving the brunt of the attention. Most exciting, I guess, is that the previously beta-only screensaver feature for Big Picture Mode is now live for the general public. In its default mode the screensaver will display art from recently played games, as well as any recent screenshots you've taken. But you can add your own custom screensavers too, which is nice.

Valve also has "a retro inspired bouncing logo screensaver" which you can select in the new dropdown menu found under Settings / Customization. As the name implies, the Steam logo bounces around a black screen, changing color every time it hits an edge. Valve has not made this screensaver the default screensaver, and it's lucky that it didn't: it's a work of diabolical cruelty. It will drive you to despair.

The screensaver references the ye olde screensaver built into DVD players in the late '90s and early '00s. If you're too young to remember it firsthand you've probably heard of it: a DVD Video logo bounces around a black screen, changing color every time it hits an edge. This unassuming but actually-quite-psychologically-damaging display has gone viral several times over the last decade or so, to the extent that, if you Google it, the Google logo will bounce around the search results page. It even has a Wikipedia page .

Why? Everyone subjected to it in the pre-social media era seems to have experienced the same intense desire for that DVD Video logo to perfectly hit the corner of the television's display. And how often does that happen? Extremely rarely.
If you don't know what I'm talking about, it's essential that you watch this ten hour video of the DVD Video screensaver:

People say smartphone screens are ruining our lives, undermining our attention, destroying literacy etcetera, and I mostly agree. But at least they've saved us from the hypnotic tyranny of the goddamned bouncing DVD logo screensaver. Screw that thing.

Anyway, Valve has its own version now, and after watching it—mostly against my will—for about half-an-hour while I ate my lunch, I'm pretty sure this abhorrent thing never pays out with a perfect corner-hitting moment.
My suggestion? Don't even think about it. Don't even turn it on as a joke. You may never re-emerge.

Back on topic, though, this Steam client update is genuinely huge compared to the norm. Startup performance has been "improved" to some unspecified degree, for example. A new experimental video codec, Pyrowave, has been added to Remote Play which apparently "allows high bandwidth, low latency video streaming". Linux users get a whole bunch of tweaks and fixes too. But the focus is very much on minor improvements to Big Picture Mode, which is good news for Steam Machine and Deck users.
The update notes in their voluminous glory are here . And I repeat: don't go near the bouncing logo screensaver.

items.title: 据传《GTA 6》PC 版将在 2027 年 Q1 问世
items.summary: GamesBeat 援引四位匿名知情人士报道称，Rockstar 计划在 2027 年 Q1 推出 PC 版《GTA 6》，也就是说 PC 版将在 3 月 31 日之前发售，仅比 2026 年 11 月 19 日发售的主

content.v: GamesBeat 援引四位匿名知情人士报道称，Rockstar 计划在 2027 年 Q1 推出 PC 版《GTA 6》，也就是说 PC 版将在 3 月 31 日之前发售，仅比 2026 年 11 月 19 日发售的主机版晚不到 5 个月。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/3b941cd17e7799a564659005c1731d01/

如果此事属实，这将是近年来 PC 版出得最快的 Rockstar 主力游戏：《GTA 5》主机版在 2013 年 9 月 17 日发售，而 PC 玩家要等到 2015 年 4 月 14 日才能玩上，中间隔了 19 个月；《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》主机版在 2018 年 10 月发售，PC 版则是在 2019 年 11 月问世，相隔 13 个月。《GTA 4》和《GTA 3》的 PC 版都比主机晚了大约 7 个月。
目前 Rockstar 尚未回应此报道。

items.title: 马斯克吐槽内存制造商漫天要价：惟美光保持合理定价
items.summary: 马斯克吐槽内存制造商漫天要价：惟美光保持合理定价

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141048599191.png
北京时间10月14日，埃隆·马斯克在其拥有的社交平台X上公开批评当前内存市场的定价策略，称许多内存制造商普遍存在漫天要价的情况，同时特别点名美光，认为该公司仍在保持合理定价。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141048078183.png
马斯克还表示，美光的做法有利于赢得客户的长期忠诚度。在他看来，企业如果只顾着通过高价获取短期收益，可能会损害与客户之间的长期关系；相较之下，维持合理价格更有助于建立稳定的合作关系。不过，马斯克并未在相关发言中详细说明具体涉及哪些内存产品，也没有公布各家厂商的实际报价对比。
值得注意的是，马斯克此前已经透露，特斯拉正在调整旗下AI芯片的内存配置，以减少对DRAM的需求。按照此前披露的信息，AI5芯片配套的LPDDR5内存容量将从144GB降至96GB，AI6芯片配套的LPDDR6内存则将从216GB降至144GB，两者的内存容量均削减了三分之一。
这意味着，在内存成本受到关注的背景下，特斯拉不仅在讨论供应商的定价策略，也在通过调整芯片设计来控制内存使用量。不过，目前没有证据表明此次容量调整完全由内存价格上涨所导致。

items.title: 微软成立 Xbox Labs 团队，负责“探索新兴概念”
items.summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma 今日宣布成立名为 Xbox Labs 的新部门（ Xbox Labs 官网链接 ），负责“将新兴概念转化为玩家和开发者可以体验的东西”。 Asha 没有点明“新兴概念”的具体含义

content.v: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma 今日宣布成立名为 Xbox Labs 的新部门（ Xbox Labs 官网链接 ），负责“将新兴概念转化为玩家和开发者可以体验的东西”。
Asha 没有点明“新兴概念”的具体含义，不过她提到了近期玩家们通过 AI 实现的游戏移植和大型 Mod。
在一封发给全体员工的公开信中，她表示：
“在最近几周，我们看到一些游戏被快速反编译、重构，从而运行在原本不支持的硬件上。我们看到 Windows PC 游戏被转换成可以用 Apple芯片运行，或是通过 WebAssembly 和 WebGPU 被移植到浏览器上运行，而 WebGPU 现已获得全球近 90% 浏览器支持。
“更令人意外的是，我们还看到一些全球最顶级的游戏被混合进了另一款游戏的源代码之中。”
她指的应该是近期 Mod 作者们利用 AI 实现的各种混搭 Mod，例如将《超级马力欧 64》和《我的世界》搬进《艾尔登法环》，或者将《漫威蜘蛛侠》融进《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆骑士》。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/3372bdde3f838315e430a3bf01ac83c7/
Asha 接着写道：“这些尝试正在挑战游戏行业长期以来的一些固有认知：软件与硬件之间的绑定关系、创作与游玩之间的界限，以及玩家发现和体验游戏的方式。
“虽然我们很难1准确预测游戏行业的未来，但有一点很明确： 让优秀的游戏更容易被接触到，让老游戏焕发新生，并让更多玩家成为创作者乃至共同创作者 ，这些可能性都值得探索。这对玩家而言无疑是好事，即便（在一定程度上，也恰恰是因为）它可能会挑战我们现有的商业模式。
“为了探索这些可能性，我已委托（Xbox 首席技术官 Scott Van Vliet）牵头成立 Xbox Labs。这是一个由游戏开发者、工程师和科学家组成的小型团队，他们的任务是将新兴的概念转化为我们的玩家和开发者能够实际体验的成果。我们将公开透明地进行开发，从用户的实际行为中学习，并以‘是否有更多人参与游玩和创作’作为衡量成功的标准。”
Asha 最后强调说，这不会改变 Xbox 的“核心方向”，Xbox 将继续致力于制作优秀游戏，继续投入硬件业务，同时会负责任地管理旗下 IP 以及围绕这些 IP 建立起来的玩家社区。

items.title: 马斯克首次与小女儿同框嗨翻全场 刚与孩子妈分手
items.summary: 特斯拉在得州超级工厂办第三届X Takeover车主活动，特斯拉创始人马斯克在活动上首次带小女儿出镜。

content.v: 近日，特斯拉在得州超级工厂办第三届X Takeover车主活动，特斯拉创始人马斯克在活动上首次带小女儿出镜。
现场视频显示，小女孩在镜头前调皮吐舌、开心互动，现场观众纷纷呼应并拍照记录。马斯克笑着告诉女儿他们是“特斯拉的支持者”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_zy_red_164_9/1384.jpg
据悉，当时马斯克正在直播聊特斯拉新车计划，他提到，参观竞争对手的工厂时，并没有看到很多定制化设备，而他的公司在定制化设备方面经验丰富；他相信这专长能够用来改善生产流程。
马斯克说，“我想这么讲是准确的，这是全世界最难做的事情之一”。
“我不想自满或自以为是，但我想，我们将可以找出方法去造出优于所有对手的芯片。老实说，我不知道要花多少时间，或许是好几年”。马斯克表示。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_zy_red_164_9/1577.jpg
随后，小女儿Azure突然走进房间、闯入镜头，一句“Hi，Daddy！”，又扭头对着现场现场上千车主吐舌做鬼脸，逗得全场大笑。这也是马斯克头一回带着这个女儿公开出镜。
马斯克当场把她介绍给全场观众，随后很快结束访谈，说要去陪孩子。这个“突然切换到奶爸模式”的在网上传播。
看到马斯克小女儿样貌，活脱脱一个小齐利斯，网友纷纷猜测她正是马斯克与齐利斯的女儿。
据此前消息，北京时间10月3日，马斯克的长期伴侣、脑机接口公司Neuralink高管希冯·齐利斯（Shivon Zilis）在X平台发文，称两人的感情关系已结束。
齐利斯在回应一条有关马斯克取消关注她的帖子时，透露了分手消息。她写道，“在毫无预兆的情况下，一周之内从相爱走到被分手，很难接受，但有时事情就是这样。”她表示，自己会非常想念马斯克。
她在帖子附上9月24日的聊天记录，当时马斯克还向她表达爱意，短短一周之后关系宣告终结。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_zy_red_164_9/11236.jpg
齐里斯坦言自己深受打击，她曾努力为马斯克营造稳定温柔的陪伴空间，尽管感情破裂，她仍希望双方保持友好，并送上对马斯克的祝福。
尽管感到失落，齐利斯仍感谢两人共同拥有的四个孩子，并表示希望今后能够与马斯克成为好朋友，共同承担养育责任。
据公开报道，Azure是马斯克与高管希冯·齐利斯所育四个孩子中的老二。
公开资料显示，希文·齐里斯1986年出生，比马斯克小15岁，更是一名AI专家。
她曾就读于耶鲁大学，加入IBM研究院，后成为马斯克旗下Neuralink的项目负责人之一。

items.title: NVIDIA推出DLSS新模式！RTX 5060性能暴增35%
items.summary: NVIDIA推出DLSS新模式！RTX 5060性能暴增35%

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141010119944.jpg
NVIDIA近日推出DLSS帧生成新模式Preset C，官方称该模式在特定条件下能够让RTX 5060的性能提升最高约35%。这项功能目前可通过NVIDIA App测试版使用，兼容RTX 40系列和RTX 50系列显卡，为玩家提供了新的性能调节选项。
根据现有信息，Preset C主要针对DLSS帧生成进行优化，目标是在生成额外画面的过程中提高运行效率。不过，性能提升并非没有代价。NVIDIA也提醒用户，更快的帧生成模式会带来轻微的图像质量妥协，因此实际效果仍需结合具体游戏、画面设置和硬件环境判断。官方所称的最高35%提升，也不意味着所有游戏都能获得相同幅度的性能增长。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141010529758.png
想要体验这一模式，玩家需要先安装NVIDIA App测试版，随后进入“Graphics（图形）→ Driver Settings（驱动程序设置）→ DLSS Override – Model Presets（DLSS覆盖——模型预设）→ Custom（自定义）→ Frame Generation（帧生成）”，最后选择Preset C即可。
对于使用RTX 5060等中端显卡的玩家来说，如果新模式能够在可接受的画质损失下换取更高帧率，或许会成为值得尝试的选项。不过，帧生成带来的额外画面并不等同于原生渲染性能提升，实际体验还应关注延迟、画面稳定性和游戏兼容性。
总体来看，Preset C为DLSS帧生成提供了新的性能取舍方案：追求更高帧率的玩家可以尝试，而更看重画面质量的用户则可以继续使用其他预设。

items.title: 重磅！大佬官宣明日放《GTA6》大料：全是独家消息
items.summary: 重磅！名记官宣明日放《GTA6》大料：全是独家消息

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140947422082.jpg
据最新消息，彭博社知名游戏记者杰森·施赖尔（Jason Schreier）将于明日发布一篇关于《GTA6》开发过程的重磅报道，深入揭秘这款备受期待的开放世界大作背后的故事。此次报道预计将涵盖游戏开发的多个方面，包括项目面临的挑战、Rockstar内部工作文化的变化，以及游戏开发周期为何如此漫长。
据透露，施赖尔此前曾前往Rockstar North工作室进行采访，并获得了观看《GTA6》实机游戏内容的机会。不过，他并未获准亲自上手试玩。目前尚不清楚他看到了哪些具体内容，但此次探访也让外界对即将公布的报道更加期待。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140949394882.jpg
报道的重点之一，是Rockstar近年来加班文化的变化。工作室过去曾因高强度加班而受到关注，而《GTA6》开发周期不断延长，也让外界持续猜测其内部管理和开发进度究竟面临着怎样的挑战。施赖尔此次将尝试解释这些问题背后的原因。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140949468146.jpg
此外，Rockstar拒绝就Cyberleek相关调查作出评论。至于玩家关心的PC版发售时间，施赖尔表示自己目前没有相关细节，也无法确认此前流传的2027年第一季度发售说法是否属实。

items.title: 新游因过于恐怖被打差评 开发商：谢谢夸奖
items.summary: 由 Meetkow 开发的心理恐怖游戏《The Unworthy》目前正在 Steam 放出 Demo

content.v: 由 Meetkow 开发的心理恐怖游戏《The Unworthy》目前正在 Steam 放出 Demo。这款以“认真吓人”为目标的第一人称恐怖游戏，灵感来自一名男子在临死体验中踏入地狱的证词。玩家将在生与地狱的夹缝中醒来，躲避黑暗中试图将你困在诅咒世界里的某种存在，证明自己拥有生还的资格。不同威胁的应对方式各不相同：有的不能动，有的不能出声，有的反而必须正面面对。部分事件和遭遇还会随机发生。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132208098009.png
Demo 自 2026 年 8 月上线以来评价不俗，204 篇评测中 91% 给出推荐，达到“特别好评”。10 月 8 日，Demo 还推送了大型更新，包括视觉重构、新增区域和敌人 AI 改善。游戏还内置了一个“阈限模式”，移除敌人和跳脸惊吓，只保留不安的空间与音效，让玩家纯粹依靠氛围感受恐怖。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131842519747.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131842528091.png
开发团队近日在 X 上分享了一件有趣的事：有玩家给 Demo 打了低评价，理由竟然是“太恐怖了”。团队回应称，这或许是对恐怖游戏最高的赞美。

items.title: Xbox女阿三姐又出击！官宣成立全新团队 目标惊人
items.summary: 微软今日宣布成立全新团队Xbox Labs，以应对近期由AI驱动的游戏反编译、重编译及Mod制作浪潮。

content.v: 微软今日宣布成立全新团队Xbox Labs，以应对近期由AI驱动的游戏反编译、重编译及Mod制作浪潮。
Xbox CEO Asha Sharma在内部备忘录中表示，该团队由一小群游戏制作人、工程师和科学家组成，目标是将新兴想法转化为玩家和开发者能够实际体验的东西。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140946108278.jpg
Sharma指出，近几周出现了大量游戏被快速反编译并重建，使其能够在原本不支持的硬件上运行。
例如，Windows PC游戏被翻译到Apple Silicon平台运行，或通过WebAssembly与WebGPU在浏览器中运行——后者全球浏览器支持率已接近90%。更令人意外的是，一些大型游戏的代码被混入另一款游戏的源代码中，形成全新体验。
“这些实验挑战了行业长期以来的假设：软件与硬件之间的绑定、创作与游玩之间的边界，以及人们发现和体验游戏的方式。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140946176961.jpg
Sharma表示，“虽然很难预测游戏的未来，但让好游戏更容易获取、给老游戏新生命、让更多玩家成为创作者和共同创作者，这些可能性显而易见。即使它们挑战了我们现有的商业模式，这对玩家来说也是明显的好结果。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140946253915.jpg
Xbox Labs将采取公开构建的方式，从用户行为中学习，并以“更多人玩和创造”作为成功标准。Sharma认为，Xbox在此领域扮演重要角色：“编程已成为AI代理的第一个主要工作负载，因为它们可以编写、运行和测试软件。游戏具有许多相同特性，而人们每年在Xbox游戏上花费超过720亿小时，大约是全球编写代码时间的五倍。”
Sharma还表示，随着团队学习，微软将把构建的工具分享给行业开发者。她强调，公司优先事项不变，仍致力于“4C”、制作伟大游戏、硬件以及对IP和社区负责任的管理。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140946345524.jpg
值得注意的是，Mod作者目前正在做微软几十年来通过向下兼容计划所做的工作——让老游戏在现代硬件上运行，但他们不受微软所面临的商业模式限制。对于未经授权使用IP的问题，微软未在发稿前回应置评请求。

items.title: 悉尼妹大尺度新片大爆！流媒体上线也登顶了
items.summary: 悉尼妹大尺度新片大爆！流媒体上线也登顶了

content.v: 由西德妮·斯威尼主演的R级惊悚电影《家弑服务》（The Housemaid）持续取得商业成功。据外媒ComicBook.com报道，该片全球累计票房已达到约4.005亿美元，不仅成为导演保罗·费格职业生涯中票房最高的作品，还在登陆流媒体后击败恐怖片《后室》，登上HBO Max全球播放榜首。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140942328294.png
《家弑服务》改编自弗丽达·麦克法登2022年出版的同名小说，制作成本约3500万美元。故事围绕女主角米莉展开，她为了满足假释后的工作要求，进入一个富裕家庭担任女佣。然而，随着她逐渐了解雇主一家，才发现这个家庭隐藏着远比表面复杂的秘密。影片融合了悬疑、诱惑与反转，最终成为2025年年底的一匹票房黑马。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140942414927.png
影片最初并未被普遍看好，但上映后凭借紧张的剧情和演员之间的化学反应吸引了大量观众。尽管部分影评人认为电影沿用了传统惊悚片的套路，观众反响却相当积极，观众好评率达到92%。西德妮·斯威尼与阿曼达·塞弗里德的对手戏，也被认为是影片的重要看点。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140942488904.png
《家弑服务》的成功还为续集铺平了道路。制片方已经批准开发续作，计划继续改编原著小说系列的下一部作品，斯威尼和导演保罗·费格也预计回归，克尔斯滕·邓斯特将加入演员阵容。续集暂定于2027年12月17日上映。

items.title: TGA官方预热《GTA6》：真能赶上年度提名时间？
items.summary: TGA官方账号今日发布推文，为《GTA6》开启发售倒计时，你认为《GTA6》能否赶上今年TGA的参评资格？

content.v: 由你来说： TGA官方账号近日发布推文，为《GTA6》开启发售倒计时， 你认为《GTA6》能否赶上今年TGA的参评资格？
The Game Awards官方账号近日发布推文，为《GTA6》开启发售倒计时，配文标注距离本作还有40天。这条帖子迅速引来大量玩家，讨论热度持续走高。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101448112354.png
不少玩家在评论区调侃TGA跟着全网一起等待《GTA6》，甚至戏称可以直接把年度游戏奖杯提前刻上名字，省去颁奖悬念。但也有玩家提出了一个关键疑问：按照TGA的参评规则，《GTA6》发售时间较晚，它真的有资格参与本届TGA的评选吗？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101448211675.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101448219653.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101448212977.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101448222899.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101448252252.png
前IGN记者、圣莫妮卡工作室编剧Alanah Pearce此前表示，TGA提名名单由超过100家海外媒体与创作者组成的国际评审团匿名投票选出，Geoff Keighley本人并不参与投票。参考2025年的时间安排，虽然奖项参选截止日期为11月21日，但评审提交提名选票的时间更早，在11月17日就已经结束。《夺宝奇兵：古老之圈》就因为发售时间晚于投票节点，直接无缘当年TGA提名。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101448347959.jpg
《GTA6》定于11月19日发售，发售日落在往年提名投票结束之后，绝大多数评审在投票阶段都没有机会完整体验游戏。不过按照TGA现有规则，事情并非毫无转机。第一种方案，Rockstar可以提前向评审提供游戏评测版本，让作品在发售前进入评选，但这么做要承担游戏内容泄露的巨大风险。第二种方案，TGA选择推迟提名投票阶段，不过这项操作在奖项12年历史中从未发生，属于史无前例的破例。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101448416031.png
你认为《GTA6》能否赶上今年TGA的参评资格？欢迎在评论区分享你的看法。

items.title: 《街霸》电影首批口碑出炉！动作夸张 像打了类固醇
items.summary: 《街头霸王》电影首批口碑出炉！动作夸张 像打了类固醇

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140933358153.png
《街头霸王》真人电影即将登陆影院，首批观影反响已经陆续公开。从目前的评价来看，影片凭借夸张的动作场面、鲜明的视觉风格和对原作游戏元素的呈现获得不少好评，但也有观众认为，电影在风格与叙事方向上仍存在不足。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140931527675.png
据外媒ComicBook.com报道，影片在正式首映后获得了首批观众反馈。ComicBook.com记者Chris Killian将其形容为“打了兴奋剂（类固醇）的《拳霸天下》”，称电影拥有大量夸张、爆炸性的动作场面，同时以幽默方式致敬上世纪80年代的动作片，也对当年此类电影所推崇的过度阳刚风格进行调侃。 拳霸天下
其他观众也称赞导演北尾樱井成功融合了视觉风格、动作能量与娱乐性。影片还加入了动画片段，与真人表演相结合，成为首批反响中令人意外的亮点之一。部分观众认为，这种处理方式既能展现《街头霸王》的游戏特色，也让整体表现更具辨识度。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140933568986.jpg
不过，影片并非获得一致好评。有评论者指出，电影虽然敢于尝试大胆的创意，但部分设计反而削弱了整体效果，故事似乎没有完全确定自己的方向。即便如此，对方仍认可影片的格斗场面、动画表现以及演员们投入的表演，认为它依然是一部轻松、有趣且风格鲜明的作品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140934002341.png

items.title: 爆了！J.K.罗琳纪录片正式启动！聚焦成名|女权|LGBT
items.summary: J.K.罗琳纪录片正式启动！聚焦成名|女权|LGBT

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140922496242.png
据外媒FandomWire报道，英国广播公司BBC正在制作一部关于《哈利·波特》作者J.K.罗琳的纪录片，暂定名为《J.K. Rowling》，计划分为上下两集，预计于2027年12月播出，时间恰逢《哈利·波特》首部小说出版30周年之后。
据报道，纪录片第一集将聚焦罗琳的创作生涯，回顾《哈利·波特》系列从诞生到风靡全球的过程，并收录此前未公开的相关人士访谈。不过，罗琳本人不会接受这部纪录片的采访，但她已经知晓项目正在制作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140922577387.png
第二集的内容则可能更具争议。根据外媒Deadline披露的信息，节目将讨论罗琳围绕苏格兰独立、女权主义、言论自由和性别认同等议题发表的观点，以及这些言论如何影响她的公众形象。
罗琳与BBC的关系也颇为复杂。作为英国知名作家，她曾与BBC合作改编自己的《斯特莱克》系列小说，但她在跨性别议题上的立场也曾引发争议，并多次批评该媒体对此类问题的报道方式。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140923051817.png
BBC历史类节目委托负责人西蒙·杨认为，在《哈利·波特》首部小说问世30年后，重新审视罗琳的人生与事业正当其时。与此同时，HBO新版《哈利·波特》剧集也正在推进，纪录片预计将在其第一季播出之后与观众见面。

items.title: PS5又惨遭破解！竟能支持更多功能
items.summary: 据Twisted Voxel报道，一款名为Bypervisor Reborn、针对PS5 13.60固件的Hypervisor（虚拟机监控器）漏洞利用程序现已发布，所有尚未…

content.v: 据Twisted Voxel报道，一款名为Bypervisor Reborn、针对PS5 13.60固件的Hypervisor（虚拟机监控器）漏洞利用程序现已发布，所有尚未更新至14.00或更高版本固件的主机均在其支持范围内。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140924556866.jpg
据称，该程序能够消除此前影响已越狱主机的多项限制，这一漏洞利用了主机在退出待机模式时，Hypervisor存在的一处安全缺陷，从而允许对Hypervisor的地址空间进行读取和写入操作。该漏洞已在14.10固件中得到修复。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140925004653.jpg
目前，该程序支持13.00、13.20和13.60版本的固件，开发者也正在努力实现对更早版本的兼容，未来支持范围甚至可能追溯至6.00固件。不过，此次发布的内容还不能算是一个完整且易于普通用户使用的越狱功能增强方案，因为它尚未包含充分发挥其潜力所需的额外补丁或自制软件功能。这意味着用户仍需等待后续开发。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140925052028.jpg
预计这项漏洞利用技术带来的主要改进之一，是让运行最高13.60固件的PS5主机能够运行Linux系统。此前，PS5对Linux的支持范围更加有限，最高仅支持至7.61固件。此外，该漏洞也有望让更多可越狱的主机获得高级自制软件功能。
另一项预期改进是增强对伪装软件包（Fake Packages）的支持，这有可能让兼容的游戏备份以更少的性能和存储空间限制运行。不过，这项功能仍取决于其他尚未发布的后续开发成果。
不过，仍不建议普通用户尝试破解或越狱自己的PS5主机，不仅面临潜在的法律风险，还有“变砖”和隐私泄露甚至造成经济损失的可能。

items.title: 《幕府将军2》新版翻车！Steam差评如潮:一无是处
items.summary: 《幕府将军2》新版翻车！Steam差评如潮:一无是处

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140912393518.png
经典策略游戏《全面战争：幕府将军2》推出《Complete Edition》版本后，原本期待重温经典的玩家却迎来了一场失望。据报道，该版本在Steam上的好评率仅为19%，评价等级跌至“差评如潮”，玩家主要不满集中在技术问题、MOD支持缺失以及部分新增内容的质量上。
不少玩家指出，新版本不仅没有彻底解决原版遗留的老问题，反而引入了新的错误和性能表现问题。更令游戏社区不满的是，更新后游戏失去了对Assembly Kit的支持。该工具是玩家制作和修改游戏内容的重要工具，而《全面战争》系列长期以来高度依赖MOD社区，相关限制因此引发了强烈反弹。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140912472733.png
画面升级同样未能赢得认可。有玩家质疑开发团队使用AI技术放大图片，认为最终呈现效果并不理想。此外，新版本还增加了50个可操作势力，但部分差评玩家认为，这些势力缺乏足够独特的机制，整体平衡性也存在问题，新增数量并没有真正转化为更丰富的游戏体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140912558050.png
对于一款拥有多年历史、积累了大量忠实玩家的经典策略游戏而言，这次更新原本应该是一次重温经典的机会。然而从目前反馈来看，玩家失望的重点并不只是改动本身，而是新版本在技术质量、MOD兼容性和内容打磨方面都没有达到预期。

items.summary: 《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》媒体评价正式解禁。外媒PSU发布了本作评测文章，给出满分10分的评价，标题为“《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒…

content.v: 《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》媒体评价正式解禁。外媒PSU发布了本作评测文章，给出满分10分的评价，标题为“《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》评测（PS5）——一个历史性系列的史诗性回归”。
PSU在总评中写道：“《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》在各方面都出类拔萃，是2026年必玩游戏之一。在佳作频出的一年里脱颖而出并不容易，但Evil Empire在这个游戏史上最具历史意义的系列之一中，打造出了一部名副其实的杰作。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131650309955.png
要点如下：
距离上一部正统《恶魔城》已超12年，本作由《死亡细胞》团队Evil Empire开发，科乐美发行。
剧情设定在《恶魔城3》23年后，特雷弗·贝尔蒙特与女儿罗斯回归。罗斯击败Boss后，可将其封印进“母亲的塔罗牌”，并与之对话，部分Boss借此获得更完整的背景刻画。
战斗系统现代化：除圣鞭外，罗斯可装备剑、剑盾、拳套、长枪、双剑、大剑六种武器；塔罗牌则提供魔法攻击，每张牌含挑战任务，完成后可解锁被动技能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131650572831.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131650578048.jpg
Boss战与探索出色：系列经典敌人大量回归，Boss战后期极具挑战，地图庞大，包含巴黎街道、下水道、地下墓穴及德古拉城堡等，探索有深度。
视听表现顶级：画面风格鲜明，音乐采用电子与交响乐融合，回归“血之泪”等经典曲目，被PSU称为“年度最佳原声之一”。
主要缺点： 存档与治疗检查点稀疏，快速旅行有限，部分死亡陷阱需长时间重复跑图。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131650392635.jpg
目前，本作在Metacritic上PS5版均分86分、PC版87分，OpenCritic均分87分，媒体推荐率高达97%。游戏将于10月15日正式发售，登陆PS5、Xbox Series X|S、Nintendo Switch及PC平台。

items.title: 如果你想要廉价的历史片段，Valve 正在清理其停产的 Index VR 耳机
items.summary: The Steam Frame has rendered the tethered workhorse obsolete.

content.v: With the recently launched Steam Frame superseding the Index VR headset, Valve has heavily discounted remaining stock of the latter. The Index VR headset launched in 2019 for $499, but now you can get one for $399.20.

Keep in mind that the Index VR headset doesn't come with controllers or a base station. A package bundling those used to cost $999, but that option is no longer available and thus, there's no associated discount.

Left controller replacements and replacement tethers are going for $119.20 and $103.20 respectively. No, there aren't any right controller replacements listed. It seems that if you want controllers for your Index VR, you'll probably need to buy them elsewhere. The same goes for base stations.

"Valve Index is no longer being produced," reads a Steam news item published earlier today. "Remaining Index headsets, controllers, and accessories are still available at the new prices below while supplies last."

That "while supplies last" is crucial: obviously Valve won't be making any more, and they've given no sense of how many they have lying around. If you really want one, perhaps as a collectible, I'd probably act fast.
Valve designer Lawrence Yang indicated that Index VR was no longer being manufactured last year, but this is the first official word from Valve on the matter.

The Index was a tidy piece of kit when it launched in April 2019. Our review called it the best VR headset available, while falling short of a 2.0 approach to VR. Nowadays the thought of being tethered to a PC while using VR is a bit dated, but back then it was still the norm despite the original Meta Quest—then known as Oculus Quest—popularising cord-free VR a few months later.

items.title: Rockstar 联合创始人 Dan Houser 表示他的《马克思佩恩 3》“失败了”，我很抱歉 Danno，但这完全是错误的
items.summary: Hear me out.

others.title: “我完全错了”——Dan Houser 认为 Rockstar 的《马克思佩恩 3》是失败的

content.v: Dan Houser is a co-founder of Rockstar Games and so I would never presume to tell him he's wrong about any of the games Rockstar has made— except in this one particular instance, where I feel obligated to step up and say, 'Dan, I'm sorry bud, but you're wrong.'

The game in question is Max Payne 3 , on which Houser played a central role, and one he seems rather down on: In an interview with IGN , he said the game was a "failure" because, simply put, he's not Sam Lake, the Remedy creative director who wrote the first two Max Payne games.

As a very linear game, Max Payne 3 "was a little different" from the open world GTA games he was accustomed to, Houser said, but he also really enjoyed the experience. "I loved what we did design-wise, the way the game didn't have loads, the way it felt like a 12-hour movie, some of the visual stuff we did with words on screen.
Alas, he continued, "I felt we were creating a really cool digital noir experience, and the consensus at the time was that people hated it.

"So I got that completely wrong," Houser said. "I know Sam Lake well, and he's a very good guy and really talented. I thought we'd done a good job of doing another Max Payne game. Some people liked it; lots didn't. So we got it wrong, or I got it wrong. I failed. My bit was not a success.

"The game is beautifully made, and it wasn't as successful as it should have been. So I would say a large amount of that failure was on me as one of the people making the decisions and also as the writer, when people really missed his writing."

Max Payne 3 is a really interesting case study because it's very much a Max Payne game—grim and gritty, filled with bullet time, body drops, and snappy commentary about how much life sucks—but it's also a full-on Rockstar game, and thus a very different vibe from the previous two entries in the series. Fans who were expecting more of the same—or insisting on it, really—were bound to be disappointed.

But Max Payne 3 itself is nothing short of a brilliant, powerhouse cinematic shooter. It really does feel like "a 12-hour movie," powered by lush cut scenes, a brilliant soundtrack by industrial rock group Health, and great performances across the board, in particular from James McCaffrey in the title role.
With all due respect to Remedy, this is where McCaffrey really hit his stride, digging deep to deliver some truly great lines:

It is fair to say that Max Payne 3 wasn't a massive commercial success: In 2012, publisher Take-Two Interactive said sales of the game came in " lower than expected ," resulting in a significantly increased net loss for the quarter. But that's hardly the only measure of success, and I think it's notable that Take-Two said the same, at the same time, about Spec Ops: The Line , a game widely heralded, then and now, for its daring, subversive narrative.

Max Payne 3 was a slower burn, but I think the passage of time has given us a far better perspective on what Rockstar actually delivered: As former PC Gamer writer Andy Kelly wrote a full decade ago, "Over the years I’ve developed a greater appreciation for the risks Rockstar took in breaking Remedy’s established, and beloved, mould."

"It’s a radical departure, but it works," the other Andy wrote in his very correct take on Max Payne 3 . "It’s always interesting to see a familiar character thrust into an unfamiliar situation, and Max is hilariously out of place in Brazil. As if being a white American in a favela didn’t draw enough unwanted attention, he makes his life even more difficult by wearing the loudest Hawaiian shirt imaginable. He was comfortable in New York, but here he’s an outsider, and the game plays up to it brilliantly."

And so, Dan, with all due respect, I have to say, 'I'm sorry bud, but you're wrong.' Max Payne 3 may have been divisive in its time, and it may not have been the big hit you were hoping for, but I sure wouldn't call it a failure. I'd say Rockstar, and you, absolutely nailed it.

content.v: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil film was released to critical acclaim last month, with more than one reviewer calling it ' the best videogame movie ever .' Another review dropped today, from none other than Hideo Kojima, and it's (seemingly) a glowing one.
"I wasn’t particularly interested at first, but since it’s Zach Cregger’s latest film, I went to see Resident Evil," Kojima posted on Twitter on October 12.

"Right from the opening, it hits you with music reminiscent of "The Thing." From there, it’s a relentless barrage of classic horror techniques, terrifying situations, and jump scares that never lets up until the very end."

That bit is sorta why I said seemingly above. Do I detect a little backhanded praise? Calling it a "relentless barrage" isn't necessarily a compliment, saying a director used "classic horror techniques" could be a way of saying it's unoriginal, and pointing out that there are "jump scares" throughout might suggest it's not a particularly sophisticated film.
Or, maybe I'm coloring Kojima's statements with my own paranoia which endlessly scans any compliment I'm given for potential criticism. You be the judge.
Anyway, here's the real meat of Kojima's little review:

"This isn’t a film adaptation of Resident Evil. It’s a film about the experience of playing Resident Evil, controller in hand," Kojima continued. "It reminded me of how I felt when I first played the original Resident Evil on PlayStation back in 1996. I was just like Bryan in this movie. I kept getting game over after game over, shouting 'F***!' over and over again. lol"

Preach. The movie was so much fun because it really did feel like you were watching someone play the game, as Bryan dealt with the horrors he faced the same way we all do in a Resi game: by screaming, running, and often demonstrating terrible aim. As Elie observed, the Resident Evil movie is the best because Bryan sucks .
I've embedded Koj's tweet below, and you should check it out because it includes a picture of the Japanese poster for the Resident Evil movie. It's rad.

I wasn’t particularly interested at first, but since it’s Zach Cregger’s latest film, I went to see “Resident Evil.” Right from the opening, it hits you with music reminiscent of “The Thing.” From there, it’s a relentless barrage of classic horror techniques, terrifying situations, and jump scares that never lets up until the very end. This isn’t a film adaptation of “Resident Evil.” It’s a film about the experience of playing “Resident Evil,” controller in hand. It reminded me of how I felt when I first played the original “Resident Evil” on PlayStation back in 1996. I was just like Bryan in this movie. I kept getting game over after game over, shouting “F***!” over and over again. lol I’m also happy I managed to pick up a program for “Digger.” October 12, 2026

content.v: 本·阿弗莱克在Happy Sad Confused播客中回忆，刚成名后，他曾有约三年几乎不出门，选择在家玩《 星际争霸 》，而不是参加好莱坞聚会。如今他仍玩《无畏契约》，但他说自己经常被从小接触这类游戏的年轻玩家压制。

content.v: Rockstar公布的一张《GTA6》截图引发玩家对杰森与露西亚结局的猜测。画面中，两人靠近彼此，似乎即将亲吻；周围还能看到直升机，以及载有持枪警员的数艘警艇。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791928089_200260_jpg_r.jpg
亲密动作与警方包围同时出现在画面里，让部分玩家猜测这可能是故事后段的场景，甚至与两位主角的结局有关。R星此前曾用“邦妮与克莱德”式描述游戏故事，也让这幅画面引出关于悲剧收尾的联想。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791928088_538995_jpg_r.jpg
《给他爱5》发售前也曾有一幅宣传画，画中主角站在打开的汽车后备箱旁。玩家后来才发现，那幅画与游戏的一种结局有关。不过，这个先例不能证明《GTA6》截图同样展示了结局。
这张截图没有注明对应哪段剧情，也未说明是否取自游戏中的实际过场。宣传图可能是专门制作的展示画面；即使取材于游戏，单张画面也未必交代完整的前因后果。杰森与露西亚的具体结局仍属于玩家推测。

content.v: 以“Levelord”之名为玩家熟知的关卡设计师Richard Gray去世，享年68岁。他曾参与《 毁灭公爵3D 》的关卡与地图设计。Apogee Entertainment已发文悼念，提及他对玩家和开发者留下的影响。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791928039_448568_jpg_r.jpg
Apogee创始人Scott Miller回忆，自己看到Gray制作的《毁灭战士》关卡后，于1994年聘用了他。Miller称赞Gray善于推动引擎能力，并运用传送门等手法设计关卡。
1996年，Gray参与了《毁灭公爵3D》的关卡与地图设计。游戏中“你不该出现在这里”这句隐藏彩蛋，也与他的关卡一道留在玩家记忆中。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791928040_233849.jpg
离开3D Realms后，Gray联合创办了Hipnotic Interactive，这家公司后来更名为Ritual Entertainment。他后续参与的射击游戏包括《雷神之锤：阿玛戈之灾》《罪恶》和《星际迷航：精英部队2》。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791928040_501023.jpg
多位开发者也发文悼念Gray，回忆他的创造力、幽默感，以及他对同行的帮助。目前，Gray的死因尚未正式公布。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 《英雄联盟》26.21版本计划调整28名英雄，改动包括增强、削弱和其他调整，重点是稳定赛季末的排位环境。目前这些内容仍处于预告阶段，尚未作为正式版本上线。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791927941_101766_jpg_r.jpg
26.21版本预计于下周推出，将是世界赛版本之后的首次更新，也是2026年余下四次更新之一。前一版本重点服务职业赛事，接下来的改动则转向赛季末排位。
首席玩法设计师Matt Leung-Harrison表示，团队希望保留英雄各自的长处，同时重新分配强度，让一些因职业比赛表现而受到压制的英雄获得空间。他以阿兹尔和瑞兹为例，也提到可能通过提高法力消耗等方式，让部分英雄的弱点更加明显。
亚索和永恩计划遭到削弱。盾弓已成为两人较强的首件装备，但Matt Leung-Harrison表示，改动不会直接针对两人的被动技能与盾弓的互动。塔里克和崔斯特还计划获得体验调整，涉及终极技能与不可选中目标的互动；塔里克的Q技能也在调整范围内。

content.v: It's a big week for Battlefield 6, as the game just launched its big Season 5 update, arrived on Xbox Game Pass , and ushered in a new Game of the Year Edition. That's not all, however, as the military shooter added a big new microtransaction in the form of the Ultimate Shortcut Kit.

Similar to how these shortcut kits worked in past Battlefield games, Battlefield 6's $30 no-so-microtransaction instantly unlocks all of the game's guns for all four classes, and at 100% Mastery--this means they are fully leveled up and kitted out.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/guns.jpg?w=636

People online have raised concerns about the existence of the Ultimate Shortcut Kit, saying it's unfair to allow people to buy every gun right from the start instead of grinding to progress. Other people said they welcome the Ultimate Shortcut Kit because they do not have the time or the interest in spending countless hours levelling up their guns and just want to play everything the game has to offer.

In addition to all the guns, the Ultimate Shortcut Kit for Battlefield 6 includes the Mortal Shriek dog tag and the Field Training: Cross Trained title. Below is a rundown of everything you get in the Ultimate Shortcut Kit.
Similar Ultimate Shortcut Kits for Battlefield 3 ($40) and Battlefield 4 ($50) cost more.

Battlefield 6 was 2025's best-selling game in the US, reportedly selling more than 20 million units in about three months . Despite the game's enormous success, EA cut staff at the studio after launch .

content.v: Xbox首席执行官Asha Sharma宣布成立Xbox Labs，由Xbox技术负责人Scott Van Vliet组建一支小型团队，探索游戏新技术。团队计划把新想法转化为玩家和开发者能够亲自体验的成果，具体项目尚未公布。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791927050_819602_jpg_r.jpg
这支团队将由游戏创作者、工程师和科学家组成。Sharma表示，Xbox Labs会公开开展工作，并以人们是否在意实际推出的作品来衡量成效。
谈及新技术的可能方向时，Sharma举出了一些现有尝试：有人将游戏重新构建，让它在原本不支持的硬件上运行；有人把Windows PC版本移植到Apple Silicon，或借助WebAssembly和WebGPU让游戏进入浏览器。这些例子并非Xbox Labs已公布的项目。
公告结尾提到了能够编写、运行和测试软件的智能体，但没有直接使用“AI”一词。Kotaku据此认为，Xbox Labs的成立与生成式AI游戏项目的兴起有关。Sharma接任后曾取消一项原计划推出的生成式AI游戏教程功能，Xbox此前推出的一批AI功能也曾引起网上反感。目前Xbox Labs将拿出哪些可用成果仍待公布。

content.v: 前顽皮狗动画师Rico Flores认为，《星际：异端先知》的战斗可能接近现代《战神》，还预计游戏会加入更多物理互动。顽皮狗此前表示，本作将是工作室迄今动作元素最多的游戏，但尚未完整展示战斗系统。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791926890_735791_jpg_r.jpg
Flores谈到角色持剑跃起、迎战巨型机器人的画面时，表示这一动作让他联想到《战神》的战斗表现。他也希望本作在战斗设计上有更大胆的尝试。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791927408_826673_jpg_r.jpg
战斗接近《战神》以及加入更多物理互动，都是Flores依据现有画面提出的预测。顽皮狗目前确认的是游戏的动作比重；实际战斗节奏、剑术表现和物理玩法，仍需等待更完整的展示。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 传奇关卡设计师理查德·“Levelord”·格雷去世
items.summary: Gray got his start with Duke Nukem 3D, before moving to co-found Ritual Entertainment.

content.v: Richard Gray, better known to gamers of a certain age as Levelord, has died. Gray's death was reported on social media by Apogee Entertainment, who paid tribute to his "legendary work on Duke Nukem 3D" and the lasting legacy he left behind.

We are deeply saddened by the passing of Richard “Levelord” Gray.From his legendary work on Duke Nukem 3D to the countless players and developers he inspired, Richard leaves behind a lasting legacy.Rest in peace, Levelord.

Gray worked as a level and map designer on numerous shooters in the late 1990s and early 2000, beginning with Duke Nukem 3D in 1996. Shortly after that game launched, he left 3D Realms and co-founded Hipnotic Interactive, later renamed to Ritual Entertainment, where he worked on games including Quake: Scourge of Armagon, Sin, Star Trek: Elite Force 2, Counter-Strike: Condition Zero, 25 to Life, and others.
He also earned a very specific fame for his "You're not supposed to be here" Easter egg in Duke Nukem 3D, which was only accessible via cheating.

Gray came to the game business at a (relatively, for the industry) advanced age. In a 2016 interview with Duke64Nukem.com he said he was 35 when he made his first Doom level, calling himself "a late bloomer with games," while Apogee founder Scott Miller said Gray was "in his 40s" when the studio hired him out of the Doom mod scene to work on Duke Nukem 3D.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Zvzzdm7eKVFmmyR5nt7Pj9-1920-80.png

"I hired him to work on Duke 3D in 1994, after seeing some of his really impressive Doom levels—he was pretty active in the mod scene," Miller shared with PC Gamer. "He then moved to Dallas, and worked from our offices. He got along well with everyone and impressed everyone with his dedication and talent. Richard loved to push the engine to its limits and he came up with a lot of fun level design tricks, using portals for example, that our other level designers learned from.

"Richard was also so helpful to anyone who approached him for help getting into the industry or becoming a better designer. He had a terrific sense of humor, too. For example, in Duke 3D he made this hung jury room. A real legend."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nzjdXLeW7Krd2bWqdgrnDF-1920-80.jpg
Other developers also paid tribute to Gray on social media:

Frederik Schreiber , Slipgate Ironworkers CEO: "Richard was, without a doubt, one of the kindest people I’ve ever met in the games industry. Incredibly humble, remarkably intelligent, endlessly creative, and always a pleasure to be around. Despite everything he had accomplished and the enormous influence his work had on my generation of game developers, he never carried himself as anything other than a genuinely good human being."

Richard B. Gray - LEVELORD11/15/1957 - 10/12/2026Just heard the news that an old friend of mine has passed on. Richard Gray - aka Levelord has departed the planet. I know he's dealt with cancer on and off for awhile now, a word that I cannot stand. Word comes from his wife Olga.

Andrew Hulshult , composer: "Richard Gray was one of those industry vets I always looked forward to hanging out with when I had the chance. He was VERY smart and I always felt like I learned something just from hanging out with him. I'm thankful Rob and Christine Atkins introduced me to him. R.I.P. friend."
Cliff Bleszinski , Gears of War creator: "RIP Richard 'Levelord' Gray. You broke the mold, fella. Guy paved the way for so many level/environment designers."

Devastating news today. Richard “Levelord” Gray was such a great guy. Like many of our friends, I wish I could have hung out with him again. He was full of life, a gentle soul, and an excellent level designer. He was called “Levelord” for a reason.
I loved the first episode of DN3D but was more drawn in by E2 and E3 that had such distinctive designs. We’re gonna miss you, man. You were one of the best.
Siegler said Gray had struggled with cancer "on and off for a while now." but the cause of death was not announced. He was 68.

items.title: 您会为了下个月发布的《GTA 6》而请假吗？
items.summary: We are just a little over 30 days until the release of GTA 6, which begs the question: will you be taking time

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/29/9245b6dd45a143b26a7877ec5a29bb5c3fc00eda-1790721291674.webp
We are just a little over 30 days away from the release of GTA 6 , which begs the question: Will you be taking time off of work or school to play it?

GTA 6 is one of the biggest pop culture events of the decade, if not in all of history, and as a result, it's expected to cause some disruption. In addition to fears that the game's highly-anticipated launch may create instability for ISPs and platform servers, many companies are also expected to have an irregular amount of employees calling out for the day. For months, fans on social media have been claiming they're putting in PTO requests well in advance of November to ensure they can have the game's release weekend available. So, will you be taking November 19 off? Let us know in the poll below, dear reader.

Economists have estimated that there will be a $1 billion loss in productivity during launch week due to people being absent from their jobs. A car tuning company known as Burger Motorsports has even announced that it will be closed on November 19 , the day of the game's release, due to an excess of employees requesting that day off. The Australian government has also released some interesting PSAs, informing citizens about their rights when it comes to taking time off around the release of GTA 6 .

The U.S. Army even offered soldiers four days of time off for the game's launch if they reenlist . NBA star Steven Adams also joked that the various sports leagues would see a drop in performance due to the release of GTA 6 . Of course, Rockstar is ensuring that, regardless of performance, sports fans are hyper-aware of its upcoming game thanks to an unprecdented GTA 6-themed NBA regular season game in Miami and a blitz of advertising at the Hard Rock Stadium where the Miami Dolphins play .

It's likely we will see a slew of other companies joining in on the GTA 6 hype as the game's launch approaches. Rockstar Games is making sure the whole world knows that its highly-anticipated release is nearly here after multiple delays. A plethora of ads have been spotted in and around Miami, New York City, and Paris. Rockstar is also investing a boatload of cash into the game's music, as it has produced an album filled with original music from the likes of Cardi B, Travis Scott, and Keith Richards . The game's radio stations will also be hosted by major musicians like Lana Del Rey, Morgan Wallen, and Bad Bunny, where they will play a variety of mainstream hits.
The 13-year wait for a new GTA game is nearly over as GTA 6 will release on November 19 for Xbox Series X|S and PS5. A PC version is also rumored to release in the first quarter of 2027 .

content.v: 《雾锁王国》1.0版将于10月15日登陆PC和PS5，扩展地图并增加战斗内容。Keen Games创意总监Antony Christoulakis表示，游戏玩家数已超过500万；团队此前曾将工作室的未来押在这款作品上，游戏取得的成绩也超过了内部预期。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791924257_921231_jpg_r.jpg
《雾锁王国》于2024年初进入Steam抢先体验，四天内售出100万份，同年8月销量超过300万份。此次公布的超过500万是玩家数，并非销量。
1.0版的新地图将向北延伸，开放此前无法进入的区域，接续现有进度作为终局内容。已有的玩家基地不会受到影响，旧存档也能继续使用。
战斗方面，法师将获得重击、跳跃攻击和更多法术。各职业会加入新技能与装备，等级成长路线也将延长；现有敌对阵营还会增加敌人类型。基地系统则将加入Sparkworks逻辑系统，玩家可用它制作可互动的内容，并通过分享平台交流。
PS5与PS5 Pro版本均以60帧为目标，1.0版首发时暂不支持跨平台联机。Xbox Series S|X版本已推迟至2027年春季。

content.v: Part of World of Warcraft: Forever's charm is that combat is considerably slower than the regular version of the MMO. It's the kind of game where you'll spend 38 seconds hitting a scorpion because there are so few buttons to press in the early stages of your journey.

Classes in WoW's past were simple, but had small quirks to them that you'd pick up over time. Melee classes, for example, can squeeze abilities in between their auto attacks to maximize their damage output. You'd never care about this if fights only took 10 seconds, like they do in WoW today, but back then you had to use all that time in more drawn-out battles for something .

The WoW: Forever beta has reminded me how satisfying it is to play a class that isn't built like Whac-A-Mole, where the challenge is to hit the right buttons the moment they start to glow. There's a rhythm to WoW's old classes and I'm delighted to hear that Blizzard fully intends to maintain it in WoW: Forever.

Blizzard developers told TechRadar that they want "to err on the side of simpler classes, but with engaging depth," and that all of it will align with its guiding principle of staying true to the old MMO's "core design, pacing, and tone."
"The level of mechanical complexity found in the beta classes is indicative of our intentions," Blizzard says.

That suggests to me that Blizzard isn't trying to speed up the pace of combat, nor will it look to shore up a class' weaknesses by adding new abilities where there were none before. My level 15 paladin will never graduate out of spending most of her time smacking monsters with a hammer while she waits for her Judgement ability to come back up. I won't ever have so many abilities on my bars that I'll need to refer to an infographic to understand which one to press first.

A strict adherence to the methodical combat of yore also means dungeons and raids will follow suit. Blizzard says encounter design will remain relatively simple so that some of the challenge will be found in preparing for them via gear sets, consumables, and team composition. I am skeptical that this will convince me to go back to farming for crafting items before every raid like I did as an over-achieving teen, but I can still appreciate that someone could take the time to do that again.

All of this makes me excited to see how creative the developers get with items that let WoW's old classes bend the rules a bit. Players have already discovered a sword for mages that deals bonus fire damage on frozen targets, for instance, which opens the door for more opportunities to play classes in ways you would've never seen in WoW's early days. My guess is this is what will ultimately drive players to stick around and make new secondary characters as part of Blizzard's goal to keep progression in WoW: Forever incremental and "horizontal".

content.v: 《EA SPORTS大学橄榄球》系列自2024年回归后取得了较高销量，但多名消息人士担忧其长期运营成本。球员授权费用上涨是主要压力之一；如果收入无法跟上支出，未来五年的持续运营可能承压。消息人士认为，该系列接下来几年仍会推出新作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791923907_623204_jpg_r.jpg

《EA SPORTS大学橄榄球25》是2024年美国销量第二高的游戏，《EA SPORTS大学橄榄球26》则位列2025年第七。与此同时，球员姓名、形象与肖像授权费用增加：按报道列出的数字，《EA SPORTS大学橄榄球25》向每名入选球员支付600美元，《EA SPORTS大学橄榄球27》的金额提高至每人1500美元，仅这一项支出就接近2000万美元。学校、碗赛等授权，以及每年的开发和营销也需要资金。
成本之外，变现方式也引发争议。报道提到，《EA SPORTS大学橄榄球27》的部分单人模式曾增加微交易并移除一些原有选项；在引发反弹后，EA撤回了新增项目。消息人士预期，未来作品仍会寻找其他变现方式。
受访消息人士对系列前景看法并不一致，也有人认为上述担忧过重，依然看好该系列。目前没有证据表明EA已决定终止系列；EA也未回应媒体的多次置评请求。

content.v: 百思买销售的Acer Predator预装游戏台式机推出500美元即时折扣，折后售价为2699.99美元。这款整机搭载GeForce RTX 5080显卡，优惠持续至本周六或商品售罄时结束。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791923780_817419_jpg_r.jpg
配置方面，该机采用Intel Core Ultra 7 265KF处理器，RTX 5080配备16GB显存，另有32GB DDR5内存和1TB SSD。整机还配备240毫米一体式水冷和850瓦电源。
IGN将这款整机定位于4K游戏，认为其处理器与显卡组合足以应对要求较高的作品。文中以《毁灭战士：黑暗时代》《光与影：33号远征队》《战地6》《死亡搁浅2：冥滩之上》和《红色沙漠》为例，提及这些游戏采用有助于提高帧率的图形功能。这是对硬件能力的概括性评价，具体表现仍取决于游戏和画面设置。
这项优惠有截止时间，也可能因售罄提前结束；购买时的售价和库存应以百思买商品页面为准。

content.v: Epic Games提出在游戏开发中加速采用AI后，曾参与《堡垒之夜》制作的Aakash Gupta谈到了这一方向。他认为，Epic掌握虚幻引擎，AI功能进入开发者常用的工具后，将推动相关功能在实际工作中得到使用。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791923726_805240_jpg_r.jpg
Gupta表示，Epic一旦决定转向，内部团队、负责人和开发路线会迅速调整。因此，他对公司提出“AI优先”的做法并不意外。
在Gupta看来，围绕AI美术、AI配音及商店披露要求的公开争论，未必能阻止开发团队使用相关功能。他还声称，Epic已将Claude和Gemini等模型接入虚幻引擎，并援引一项开发者使用AI的调查支持自己的判断。这些关于使用情况和普及趋势的说法，仍是Gupta的观点。
Epic首席执行官Tim Sweeney此前公开支持在游戏开发中使用生成式AI。随着相关功能进入开发工具，开发者如何使用、玩家如何了解其使用范围，也成为这场讨论的一部分。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 英伟达称RTX Spark首发支持数十款AAA游戏 正推进反作弊兼容
items.summary: 英伟达宣布，面向下一代AI原生PC的RTX Spark上市时将支持数十款AAA游戏在Windows 11运行，目标是提供1440p游戏体验。英伟达同时正与微软及游戏开发者合作，处理竞技类在线游戏的反作弊兼容问题。RTX

content.v: 英伟达宣布，面向下一代AI原生PC的RTX Spark上市时将支持数十款AAA游戏在Windows 11运行，目标是提供1440p游戏体验。英伟达同时正与微软及游戏开发者合作，处理竞技类在线游戏的反作弊兼容问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791923576_434489.jpg
RTX Spark由20核Grace CPU和GeForce RTX Blackwell集成GPU组成，后者拥有6144个CUDA核心。游戏适配分为两条路径：与开发者合作制作面向Spark平台的移植版本，以及通过系统接口和图形接口转换运行原本为其他平台开发的游戏。
反作弊是Windows Arm设备运行部分竞技类网游时需要处理的问题。现代反作弊方案常依赖内核模式下与硬件交互来建立可信链；为Windows x64开发的游戏通过转换层在Windows Arm64设备上运行时，这类交互可能出现问题。英伟达表示，相关合作旨在维持反作弊在硬件端的可信链。
列入兼容目标的在线游戏包括《反恐精英2》《刀塔2》《堡垒之夜》《漫威争锋》《永劫无间》《火箭联盟》《腐蚀》《THE FINALS》《战争雷霆》和《坦克世界》。这些作品被列为适配目标，所公布的内容未逐款给出测试结果。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 近日Dan Houser回顾《恶霸鲁尼》的开发经历时表示，制作全新作品已有压力，发售前围绕游戏名称出现的争议又分散了团队的注意力。他认为，这款作品因此没有得到应有的关注。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791923531_856154_jpg_r.jpg
Houser认为，制作一款此前没人做过的新游戏，本身就会给团队带来压力。《恶霸鲁尼》在《GTA：圣安地列斯》面世仅一年多后推出，也让他对那段开发经历印象深刻。
他特别提到，游戏尚未发售时，一些人还没看到作品，就因名称对它产生了误解。按Houser的回忆，团队当时不得不花费大量精力，让商店愿意进货，并设法避免游戏上市前遭到抗议。

items.title: 不止个人心魔！《寂静岭：小镇陷落》探讨社会性恐怖主题
items.summary: 近日科乐美制作人冈本基接受法米通采访，谈及《寂静岭：小镇陷落》开发思路、故事设计以及寂静岭IP后续的发展规划。2022年对外公布的寂静岭重启计划里，首批三款主力作品加上免费短篇内容现已全部推出，冈本基称自己终于松了一口气

content.v: 近日科乐美制作人冈本基接受法米通采访，谈及《寂静岭：小镇陷落》开发思路、故事设计以及寂静岭IP后续的发展规划。2022年对外公布的寂静岭重启计划里，首批三款主力作品加上免费短篇内容现已全部推出，冈本基称自己终于松了一口气，但这仅仅只是系列复苏的起点，官方已经着手筹备第二波、第三波新项目，依旧会以多部作品打包的形式推进。当年选择一次性公布多款新作，也是吸取了过往项目突然取消的教训，不想让玩家一直担心新作半路夭折，只靠单款作品很难让粉丝相信这个系列真的回来了。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791923200_639654_jpg_r.jpg

《寂静岭：小镇陷落》由Annapurna Interactive牵线，交给苏格兰小型工作室Screen Burn负责开发，这支团队大约只有30人，创作风格偏向匠人化，经常推翻已有内容重做，开发周期因此被拉长，就连发售之后的补丁也反复打磨调整。冈本基表示和海外团队合作时，科乐美不会过度插手细节，过多管控会抹杀掉工作室独有的创作特质，他们只会守住寂静岭系列最核心的底线，给创作者留出足够的表达空间，等待团队自身的创意沉淀成熟。

本作舞台设置在苏格兰小镇，全程采用第一人称视角，在这一轮重启项目当中，它的 恐怖 感是最为强烈的。画面加入电影式上下黑边，希望带给玩家观看优质海外剧集一般的沉浸感受。系列经典的收音机探测道具被 CRTV 便携显像设备取代，同样用来感知敌人、提示危险，设备自带信号不稳的失真效果，进一步烘托不安的惊悚氛围。叙事也跳出了以往聚焦个人心魔的套路，转向集体与社会层面的心理恐怖，故事围绕企业引发的灾祸席卷整座小镇展开，讲述集体作恶之下普通人背负的愧疚与挣扎，不存在简单脸谱化的反派。

游戏采用三名主角的群像叙事，从不同人物的视角去见证同一场灾难。怪物设计同样呼应集体创伤的主题，巨大的怪物形象，用来反衬个体面对庞大集体灾祸时的无力感。角色选角方式也比较特别，团队会先敲定出演的演员，再根据演员的形象去塑造对应的角色，而非做完角色模型之后再挑选演员。本作谜题难度偏高，因此内置了提示开关，玩家可以自主选择要不要借助提示解谜，官方也在思考后续作品的谜题该继续沿用这套提示机制，或是设计多套不同解法。整体基调偏向严肃成人向，几乎没有轻松搞笑的桥段。
采访里也透露了系列后续安排，初代《寂静岭》重制版确定交由Bloober Team开发，也就是《寂静岭2：重制版》的制作团队，现阶段相关细节暂时还不能对外公开。科乐美未来还会持续和世界各地不同的工作室合作打造寂静岭新作，也欢迎更多团队主动递交开发提案。这个IP不会死守单一玩法，形式上可以灵活变化，但不变的底线是心理恐怖的内核，核心始终是刻画人与内心、困境对峙的故事。
《寂静岭：小镇陷落》已于9月24日正式发售，登陆PS5和PC平台，Steam、Epic、GOG均有上架。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 发送《小丑》游戏预告片，重点展示其搞笑的、唯一的回合制角色扮演游戏战斗 | 2026 年 IGN 粉丝节
items.summary: As part of IGN Fan Fest 2026: Fall Edition, we can reveal a new gameplay trailer for Send in the Clown, the up

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/sendintheclown-trailer-blogroll-1791570179851-1791910485446.jpg

As part of IGN Fan Fest 2026: Fall Edition, we can reveal a new gameplay trailer for Send in the Clown, the upcoming one-hour comedy RPG where players become history's least-appreciated clown as he tries to save a 12-year-old's birthday from her brat brother.
Co-directors Nick Park and Jacques Mouledoux walk us through the latest look at Send in the Clown, focusing squarely on the game's climactic, one-and-only turn-based RPG battle.
Yes, the team built a whole battle system for just one fight, and all the roads that lead to it are pretty hilarious.

Players will step into the oversized shoes of Pockets as he tries to save Miranda's party from her brother Tad. To do so, he'll need to recruit characters and gather items, which will in turn unlock each character's unique ability.

For example, if he can teach a single dad how to dance, he'll unlock a dance troupe attack. If he helps hype up Miranda's friend Nasser, the team will be able to use the 'Be a Hero' move that protects an ally from damage. Lastly, if you are able to give a mother a break from watching her baby so she can lay be the pool, she will be able to throw said baby at an enemy for ultimate damage.

We also got a tease of other ways you can help turn the tide of the final battle in your favor, including finding Tad's baby photos, finding religion, and waking Nanna. Developer Mad Herons wouldn't reveal what would happen when you find those things, but the reward will surely be useful.
Send in the Clown is set to debut later this year on PC via Steam, and you can check out the demo right now.
For more from IGN Fan Fest 2026: Fall Edition, check out our main guide that explains how to watch, what to expect, and more.
Adam Bankhurst is a writer for IGN. You can follow him on X/Twitter @AdamBankhurst, Instagram, and TikTok, and listen to his show, Talking Disney Magic.

items.title: K/DA 重新激活社交账户，虚拟韩流组合时隔 6 年后卷土重来的传闻愈演愈烈
items.summary: Official K/DA accounts have been updated for the first time in six years. New profile and banner images contin

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/kdacomeback-1791909516784.jpg

Official K/DA accounts have been updated for the first time in six years. New profile and banner images continue to show the existing promotional art from the All Out era, now with the addition of hot pink flames. The reactivated accounts have also wiped existing posts, fueling rumors that the virtual girl group is gearing up for a comeback.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/kdaprofile-1791908095908.png

K/DA, which debuted at the 2018 League of Legends World Championship, consists of four League champions (Ahri, Akali, Evelynn, and Kai'Sa) voiced by international pop-stars. The group’s first single, aptly called POP/STARS, was the first K-pop song by a girl group to receive RIAA Platinum certification in 2022. The early success of the girl group prompted the release of a full EP, All Out, in 2020.
Since then, the group has pretty much gone dark. K/DA skins still exist in-game, but there’s been no word on new music or performances. Until now.
I’m not asking for much. I just want to see a teaser from K/DA that’s as peak as this. https://t.co/gWU9yf04w9

An updated banner image continues to use promotional images from the All Out era, showing the main K/DA quartet alongside the era’s guest artist, Seraphine, who was a newly released champion at the time. As of October 13, however, those images also show the addition of hot pink and magenta flames .

Data-mined leaks from earlier this year already raised hopes that the group would have some role in the current season of League of Legends. Details in a Wild Rift update, first spotted by SkinSpotlights , pointed to a potential “Firestarter” skin concept, as well as a new song registered on the ASCAP Repertory.
Other users have interpreted the purple smoke as a sign that K/DA is being added to Fortnite, which is currently using similarly colored imagery for its Fortnitemares event .
The question of K/DA’s return extends beyond Riot, as it also depends on the availability of the four singers associated with the group: Madison Beer, Soyeon, Miyeon, and Jaira Burns.

Online fan accounts recently started circulating the rumor that Beer would be leaving the group. The singer herself was asked about her return to K/DA during her recent Locket tour, saying : "I would love to. It’s not really up to me, although I wish it was. There actually was a conversation a few years ago about doing something again, but I don’t know what happened to it.”

Riot has yet to confirm any rumors about a K/DA comeback, let alone who the group currently includes. The League of Legends World Championship tournament is currently being hosted across the United States, with the Grand Final scheduled for November 14. Given that K/DA made its debut at the Worlds tournament, there’s a possibility we'll hear more over the course of this year's event.

items.title: Hideo Kojima Reviews The Resident Evil Movie
items.summary: Writer-director Hideo Kojima has seen Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie, and he has now shared his review. Ko

content.v: Writer-director Hideo Kojima has seen Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie, and he has now shared his review. Kojima, a true cinephile known for his public movie reviews , said he "wasn't particularly interested" in seeing the movie at first, but he did, and he sounded pretty impressed by what he saw.

"Right from the opening, it hits you with music reminiscent of The Thing. From there, it’s a relentless barrage of classic horror techniques, terrifying situations, and jump scares that never lets up until the very end," he said .

Kojima went on to observe what others did as well, which is how the Resident Evil movie is more of a film that provides the "experience of playing Resident Evil" as opposed to watching an adaptation of one of its stories.

"It reminded me of how I felt when I first played the original Resident Evil on PlayStation back in 1996," he said. "I was just like [main character] Bryan in this movie. I kept getting game over after game over, shouting “F***!” over and over again. lol."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/REMovie-Large-2.jpeg

This is the kind of response that Cregger said he wanted viewers to have. It's also what got Cregger in some hot water with hardcore fans who wanted to see a straight adaptation of one of the games instead of Cregger's own original story set inside the world of Resident Evil.

Another bright spot for Kojima? While he was at the theater, he picked up some physical reading materials for the divisive new Tom Cruise movie Digger. A lot of people have had a lot of things to say about that film, and we are all waiting to hear what Kojima thought of it, whenever he sees it.

The new Resident Evil has made more than $320 million worldwide , following its big debut in China where it's made $40.7 million so far . Cregger's Resident Evil movie is now the highest-grossing entry in the series to date , surpassing the previous record-holder, which was 2016's The Final Chapter ($312 million).
For more, check out GameSpot's rundown of the highest-grossing Resident Evil movies of all time .
While Cregger has said he has ideas for another Resident Evil movie , he’s done with franchise movies and is instead making an original movie, The Flood, next .

As for Kojima, he's keeping very busy with the upcoming games OD and Phsyint , both of which are in the works for Xbox. Physint will also be adapted for film and TV , while Kojima's Death Stranding is coming to the big screen as well.

items.title: 官方授权的《辐射》书挡现已开放预订，售价高达 325 美元

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/fallout-bookends-1791915427273.png
《辐射》系列是有史以来最受欢迎的视频游戏系列之一。当然，这意味着有大量的《辐射》周边商品。
与任何与特定 IP 相关的产品一样，您始终可以期待官方许可产品上有某种标记。然而，最近宣布的 Fallout 书立将这一点提升到了一个全新的水平，Sideshow 的售价为 325 美元。
虽然 325 美元对于手绘收藏人物来说并非闻所未闻，但对于一套书立来说，这个价格似乎过高。客观地说，目前您只需 300 美元即可从 IGN 商店购买半功能性的哔哔小子复制品。在我看来，Dark Horse 最近还推出了一套更酷的 Fallout 书挡，售价仅为 179.99 美元。
那么到底是什么让这些书挡如此昂贵呢？除了与贝塞斯达合作开发该产品的许可费外，这些书立显然每个重四磅。它们“由树脂精心雕刻而成”，并单独手绘，以实现《辐射》系列闻名的古董金属效果。
《辐射》官方书立现已开放预订，预计发货时间为 2026 年 11 月至 2027 年 1 月。根据 Sideshow 的发货政策，如果您在收到产品后不满意，该公司确实提供 30 天退货服务。
你愿意花 325 美元购买《辐射》书挡吗？
作为一个拥有很多书和许多书立来固定它们的人，对我来说，有人会花这么多钱买这样的东西，这似乎很疯狂。话虽这么说，我并不是拥有大量可支配收入的《辐射》超级粉丝，所以我可能不是此类产品的目标市场。
如果你是一个经常花很多钱购买收藏品的人，我真的很好奇这是否是一款值得花 350 美元购买的产品。

items.title: Xbox 宣布成立 Xbox 实验室，部分目的是改进可在网络浏览器中玩的旧一代游戏
items.summary: Xbox has announced Xbox Labs, a new initiative aimed at getting games to more people in more places — with a p

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/12/halospeedrunblogroll-1533336736758-1717694718988-1791846824130.jpg
Xbox has announced Xbox Labs, a new initiative aimed at getting games to more people in more places — with a particular emphasis on web browsers.

No doubt seeing the growing community of games getting improved versions ported into web browsers (like the 94fps browser version of Halo: Combat Evolved), Microsoft itself is keen to get in on the action in support of new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's goal of reaching 1 billion players per day .

Xbox has been tinkering with running Xbox and Xbox 360 games in browsers, and the Xbox Labs initiative is a formalization of those efforts that will see a small team of engineers playing with emerging technologies in order to find new ways for games new and old to be distributed and even created. And IGN understands that this won't just be an R&D effort; rather, Xbox Labs is tasked with shipping products – Sharma says, "We'll build in the open" – and getting gamers to engage with them.

I'd suggest thinking about it as a next phase of the backward compatibility efforts that started at Xbox over a decade ago, which the recent disc-to-digital program built on (which, side note, is a much more consumer-friendly path towards the seemingly inevitable digital future than what Sony is doing ), and now Xbox Labs aims to take it even further. It remains to be seen if or how Xbox will look to monetize its Xbox Labs offerings, be it via an upfront cost, in-game microtransactions, or in-game-ad-based revenue .
The Xbox Labs announcement continues a busy stretch for Xbox, which revealed its entertainment-industry-focused Xbox XP arm last week.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/xbox-labs-1791917713343.png
Here's Sharma's memo to the team (also posted to Xbox Wire ) in full:
Team,

The first video games emerged some 75 years ago. In the time since, there have been booms and busts, but every year there are more great games to play, more devices to play them, and best of all, more people than ever playing. That growth helped make XBOX what it is today, and we’ve helped shape the industry in return, from bringing hard drives to consoles and online gaming through Xbox Live to Game Pass and cloud gaming, alongside franchises that have brought millions of people together.

In recent weeks, we’ve seen games rapidly decompiled and rebuilt to run on hardware they were never originally designed to support. Windows PC builds have been translated to run on Apple Silicon or ported to run inside a browser through WebAssembly and WebGPU, the latter now approaching 90% global browser support. Perhaps more surprisingly, we’ve seen many of the biggest games in the world have been remixed into the source code of another.

These experiments challenge long-held assumptions about our industry: the tether between software and hardware, the boundary between creation and play, and how people discover and experience games. While it is hard to predict the future of gaming, it is easy to see the possibilities in making great games easier to access, giving old games new life and allowing more players to become creators and co-creators. These are unmistakably good outcomes for players, even when (and sometimes because) they challenge our existing business models. To explore these possibilities, I’ve asked Scott to stand-up XBOX LABS, a small group of game makers, engineers and scientists whose job is to turn emerging ideas into things our players and developers can experience. We’ll build in the open, learn from what people do, and measure success by whether more people are playing and creating.

I think XBOX has an important role to play here. Coding became the first major workload for agents because they can write, run, and test software. Games share many of those same properties, and people spend more than 72 billion hours a year playing XBOX games, roughly five times the estimated time spent writing code worldwide. We’ve spent 25 years learning how to make great games, and I want our game makers to help shape what these new technologies make possible. As we learn, we’ll share the tools we build with developers across the industry, just as we always have.

Our priorities aren’t changing. We remain committed to the 4Cs, to making great games, to our hardware and to being responsible stewards of IP and the communities built around it. LABS gives us a way to explore new technology without abandoning the work already underway.
Asha

items.title: 据报道 EA Sports 的大学橄榄球开发人员担心该系列可能会在 2030 年消失
items.summary: Developers working on EA Sports' College Football franchise reportedly fear that the series may not live to se

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/05/27/cf25-blogroll-1716836985997.jpg
Developers working on EA Sports' College Football franchise reportedly fear that the series may not live to see the end of the decade.

The report comes from Insider Gaming's Mike Straw , who spoke to senior-level sources working on or around the football series. He noted that, although the series is performing well, sales have gradually declined entry to entry since its highly-anticipated debut in 2024. While this isn't inherently a bad thing (or unexpected, given the extreme hype around the 2024 title), costs associated with the game have been rising.

Per the report, in 2024, EA paid each player featured in the game $600, amounting to roughly $7 million total. Those costs have tripled, with NIL (name, image, likeness) rights for college athletes now costing $1,500 per player. As a result, EA spent roughly $20 million on its players with its latest game. EA also pays boatloads of cash to license bowl games, universities, and more, meaning tens of millions of dollars goes into just having the right to use certain elements in the game as opposed to raw development costs.

This has led to EA trying to monetize key areas of the game, including College Football's single-player modes. This led to extreme backlash earlier this summer due to the fact players felt they were being pushed to pay to efficently play single-player content. EA eventually bent the knee and reversed course , but noted that it would retool these options and bring them back in future entries.

One source told Insider Gaming that microtransactions were planned to return in future College Football single-player titles, and feared that it would anger players, pushing them away from a game that is trying to grow. While there are College Football games planned for the next few years, sources reportedly fear that the franchise may be on its way out.

"We’re not FC. We’re not Madden. We don’t make the money they do, and everyone knows it," a source told Insider Gaming. "But it’s at the point where if we don’t find a way to keep players around and, in turn, make more, we won’t have anything. Forget in 10 years, I’m scared about if we have a game by the end of the decade. Games aren’t getting cheaper to make, and there’s the real concern with all of us that EA’s going to streamline and just have a few key franchises and dump everything else."

Insider Gaming noted that not all of its sources shared these fears and some believed there is a strong future with the franchise. EA Sports' College Football brand is a spiritual successor to EA Sports' highly popular NCAA football series that thrived in the 2000s and early 2010s before legal issues surrounding NIL rights effectively killed it. There was a 14-year gap between NCAA's final game and the debut of the new College Football series, which led to an extreme level of enthusiasm from fans.

It led to College Football 25 raking in big bucks and becoming the second best selling game of 2024 in the United States, though it hasn't sustained that momentum year-to-year. College Football 26 was the seventh best selling game in the United States in 2025, with College Football 27 currently placed in 10th this year. Of course, College Football also doesn't have as much global appeal as something like EA's FC series, which means its sales are primarily made up in the US.

items.title: 尽管该系列发生了巨大变化，2026 年光环节仍在继续，消息即将发布
items.summary: The big Halo Fest event planned for December is going ahead as planned, despite mass layoffs and other major c

content.v: The big Halo Fest event planned for December is going ahead as planned, despite mass layoffs and other major changes at developer Halo Studios.

Halo Studios director of competitive engagement, Tashi, confirmed this and said there will be news about Halo Fest this week. Additionally, Halo Studios will release materials "celebrating the community and 25 years of Halo," while fans can also look forward to "relevant game info" about in-market Halo games.

"There's a huge amount of Halo fans who are looking forward to the event to attend or watch from home, and we're looking forward to providing a platform for the community to celebrate 25 years of Halo and each other," Tashi said of Halo Fest.

Halo Fest takes place December 11-13 in Seattle--the event is totally sold out. "No matter why you love Halo, whether it’s the story and characters, the music, the art and universe, or just playing with friends--Halo Fest will have something for you," Microsoft said of the event.

The voices of Master Chief and Cortana, Steve Downes and Jen Taylor, will appear at Halo Fest, while there will also be a range of community events celebrating the series. Some had expected Halo Studios to announce the next big Halo game at Halo Fest, but it's not unreasonable to think that plans may have changed.

Halo Fest is happening against a major shift for the Halo franchise following the gutting of Halo Studios and the transition of the series from Halo Studios to Activision. Halo Studios now employs a significantly smaller team that will support already-released Halo games like Halo: The Master Chief Collection and Halo Infinite, but future games in the series-- including the rumored reboot --will be made at Activision.

Halo Studios was rumored to be working on Halo 2 and Halo 3 remakes, as well as a new live-service Halo game. That was before the big changes, however, and it's been reported that Activision is working on a Halo reboot.

items.title: Brandon Sanderson 的 Roshar 之战 Kickstarter 活动首日突破 100 万美元

content.v: Brandon Sanderson 和 Brotherwise Games 已正式启动新策略棋盘游戏 War of Roshar 的 Kickstarter 众筹活动。桑德森在本次竞选前一直称其为“重大事件”，球迷们似乎也同意这一点。第一天就已经认捐了超过 100 万美元，距离活动还剩 23 天。
《War for Roshar》将加入与 Brotherwise 合作的不断壮大的 Cosmere 棋盘游戏阵容。 IGN 在今年早些时候独家首次展示了这款游戏，并且非常喜欢我们所看到的内容。这是一款大型桌面战争游戏，在战略分析和抽象游戏玩法之间取得了平衡。游戏的主题深深植根于 Sanderson 的 Stormlight Archive 系列，包含来自 30 多位不同艺术家的丰富艺术作品。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/07/27/o6ebk3lg-1785167443134.png
如果您想支持该项目，有多种选择。这个名为“第五理想”的特色承诺将为您带来几乎一切。该级别售价 295 美元，包括基础游戏、冠军扩展、3D 组件、定制卡套和木制代币。您还将获得 Cosmere RPG 的一些不同微缩模型，包括来自 Era 1 和 Era 2 的 Mistborn 模型，以配合该游戏即将推出的扩展包。
如果您不关心 Cosmere RPG 的额外附加组件，其他四个级别将为您提供这些物品的一些变化。对于基础游戏，您可以承诺 90 美元，以便在零售版本发布后立即访问。
至于游戏实际发布的时间，该活动包括预计的交付日期为 2027 年 11 月。这可能会根据游戏的运送目的地而有所不同，但桑德森以按时为其所有众筹项目交付高质量产品而闻名。
这远不是桑德森取得巨大成功的第一个众筹项目。就在今年早些时候，他发起了一场大规模的 Hoid 故事书收藏活动，最终筹集了超过 1100 万美元。这些书到达后，IGN 的乔丹·康斯托克 (Jordan Comstock) 亲自试用了这些书，并且毫不后悔自己选择支持该项目。
在该项目之前，Brotherwise game 最初于 2024 年通过 kickstarter 为 Cosmere RPG 提供了高达 1500 万美元的资助。因此，虽然“罗沙尔之战”有了一个良好的开端，但我们必须拭目以待，看看它是否有可能成为桑德森在他的 Cosmere 宇宙中有史以来最成功的众筹活动。

items.title: 据传《侠盗猎车手 6》将比任何人预期更快地在 PC 上推出，但我不会抱太大希望
items.summary: If the rumored release window is accurate, it means the new GTA will hit PC just a few months after consoles—s

content.v: A GamesBeat report claims that Grand Theft Auto 6—which still hasn't been announced for PC—will launch for PC sometime within the first three months of 2027. If correct, that means the game will drop, at most, just four months after its initial release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles.
GamesBeat cites "four industry sources familiar with the studio's plans" in its report, all of whom requested anonymity. Rockstar has not yet commented on the claim.
It's a surprising claim. Earlier this year, we predicted that GTA 6 won't likely appear on PC before November 2027 , mainly because that's just how Rockstar rolls. We always have to wait.
The Unfortunate Timeline

Compared to that, a four month break between the console and PC releases, and possibly less, seems downright snappy, especially given how the gaps between GTA games themselves have grown over the decades.
Courtesy of Wikipedia :
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PFaPD7hNPufCBKXjrg9cmL-1920-80.png

Not only would a Q1 release of GTA 6 on PC be an unusually brief break, it also puts the game in the midst of the post-holiday hangover, when we're all doing our best to nurse our bruised and battered bank balances back to health.

And that, I think, would feel especially egregious in the immediate aftermath of this year's holiday season, which for gamers will be driven by the release of GTA 6 on consoles. Rockstar loves the double dip , but punching the button again so soon after the console release would surely be viewed dimly by a not-insignificant number of people who would prefer the flexibility and power of the PC, but really don't want to wait for it.

Of course, if Rockstar or Take-Two confirms the GTA 6 PC release date really is that close—Take-Two's next quarterly financial report takes place on November 9, which might be a time for such a thing—some no doubt would wait for it, cannibalizing launch sales to some extent.

There's no shortage of people on social media saying they will indeed wait to buy GTA 6 if the PC version is indeed coming that quickly. That feeling may be even more widespread than it appears, given how much GTA 6 costs: At $100 for the premium edition and all the exclusive content it contains, you can understand why people might be more reticent about buying it multiple times than they were for earlier games in the series.
How about you?

Anything's possible, of course, and I would never presume to have a better understanding of these things than Strauss Zelnick and the rest of the GTA brain trust. But I also wouldn't bet on it—and for now I'm definitely taking all of this with a grain of salt. I've also reached out to Rockstar to ask about it, and will update if anyone answers.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZF5ZJsyvbhJRVSDmd9H3jA-1920-80.jpg

items.title: 《Red Dead》令人震惊的转折结局激怒了很多人，但 Rockstar 联合创始人表示这是正确的决定
items.summary: Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser has recalled the controversial ending to 2010's Red Dead Redemption in which th

content.v: Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser has recalled the controversial ending to 2010's Red Dead Redemption in which the main character, John Marston, is killed.

He said in an interview that the game's lead designer, Christian Cantamessa was on board with the idea to kill off Marston, but Houser wondered about the production realities of, "How does an open-world game work if you've killed the protagonist?"

"So I said, ‘I think maybe we have to kill him.’ And he goes, ‘That's a great idea. Got to do it.’ I said, ‘I don't know if… let me just think about this,’ because we're just dealing with audio and dialogue," Houser told IGN "The nature of an open-world game is you finish a story, then you go back into the world and wrap up all the side content if you want to. We'd have to play as someone else for that. We could play as Jack, but what does that mean? So I had to think through for a while what it would mean production-wise.”
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/RDR_5701c0.jpg?w=636

How Rockstar handled it was by setting RDR's epilogue years later, in the year 1914, with players taking control of Marston's son, Jack. He said this setup presented challenges, too, in terms of the technical realities of playing as Jack as opposed to John. There were story and mission concerns, too, including how multi-stage missions might play out if players, as John, completed one part and then came back to finish later as Jack.
"How would that work? We had to think through all of that stuff and concluded we could probably make it work, but we were still scared," he said.

The RDR epilogue has Jack hunting down and killing the men who killed his father, and Houser said players "really loved" that feeling of vengeance. Ultimately, Houser observed that there was "broad consensus" that it was the right call in the end to kill off John, even if it was an "unusual and out-there decision." Houser was, however, surprised by "how angry some people were about that decision."

"There were people who were livid with you. And part of you goes, ‘That's fantastic,’ because it means you've really engaged in the story and the characters," he said. "Now, I think it was the right decision because you want those big, strong reactions, but I think people were really confused by it. As a writer, it was like he had to die for the story to have any weight."
Also in the interview, Houser said he wanted to achieve something like this in the GTA franchise, but it never happened due to technical reasons.

He and the Rockstar team did, however, pull it off again with Red Dead Redemption II, which is a prequel to the earlier game. RDR2 famously killed off its own main playable character, Arthur Morgan, though he died from tuberculosis or at the hand of Micah. RDR 2 had an epilogue as well, featuring John and Jack Marston.

Houser left Rockstar in 2020 and now works at Absurd Ventures, which is crafting an open-world comedy game. His brother, Sam Houser, remains at Rockstar and helped lead the team bringing GTA 6 to market on November 19.

items.title: Nvidia 将 DLSS 5 引入霍格沃茨遗产，但一些粉丝无法辨别差异
items.summary: About a month after it debuted in NBA 2K27, DLSS 5 is now being added to Hogwarts Legacy, with a new, faster m

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/06/12/hogwarts-switch-oo-1749763392003.jpg
About a month after it debuted in NBA 2K27, DLSS 5 is now being added to Hogwarts Legacy , with a newer, faster model.

In a blog post, Nvidia announced that it is launching a new model for DLSS 5 that's — according to Team Green — twice as fast as the model that debuted in NBA 2K27 last month . While the basketball game will be getting an update that adds this new model, and thus improves performance, Nvidia is also bringing the neural rendering tech to Hogwarts Legacy and Where Winds Meet in November.

Nvidia has been hard at work getting DLSS 5 to run well enough that people will actually turn it on when they're playing games. It's not hard to see why that's a major focus; when I first tested the tech back in September , I found that it could absolutely cripple my frame rate at 4K on the RTX 5090. It wasn't long ago, either, that Nvidia debuted the technology at GTC 2026 in March , where it needed to run on two RTX 5090s to deliver a playable experience, and even then it was super limited.

Now, though, Nvidia claims the new model is twice as fast as September's model, and ten times faster than it was when DLSS 5 was first revealed. If that's true — and I won't know that until I actually test it — it makes sense that developers are now willing to add the feature to their games.

But unlike some of the deep-fried examples I've seen of DLSS getting modded into games, the Hogwarts Legacy examples Nvidia shared in its blog are a lot more subtle. Rather than completely changing the way characters look, like it did when DLSS 5 was first revealed, it mostly just looks like it balances lighting and subsurface scattering.

And I'm not alone there. Over on X/Twitter, NikTek posted a GIF of him scrubbing through an image comparison with DLSS 5 turned on and off, and noted how small of a difference it makes. He then wonders who would actually use it with such a minor visual change and a big performance hit. However, there were some folks who applauded the subtle changes, with jayv7s replying, "This is the correct way to use it, no exaggerated AI slop filters on top, just normal pure improvement."

However, the subtlety of DLSS 5 will ultimately depend on the developer. There are plenty of dials that devs can adjust to make the game look as natural as possible, or leaning in the opposite direction to make games look like some kind of nightmare ripped straight from Midjourney. However, it is at least a little bit reassuring that in NBA 2K27 and now in Hogwarts Legacy, the developers are at least trying to maintain the same aesthetic.

No matter how subtle it is, though, DLSS 5 does work by using AI to re-draw games , even though it is anchored by the geometry and color data provided by the game. That's definitely enough to turn some people off of this tech, but if the changes are subtle enough and the performance continues to improve at this pace, I can see it eventually getting added to more than one or two games.

Fixes for the Mission Editor, failures to authenticate to Epic Online Services on PS5, and issues with laser or flashlight attachments emitting from misaligned positions from weapons are also among the changes made.
Update Day General FAQ:
Q: ‘My game mods broke on PC with this update, why did that happen?’

> A: When Ready or Not or games in general release updates to the game, the files for the game in areas related to new game content or fixes then changes. If mods were using the old files to function that have since changed to new files, those mods will likely need to update in order to work properly with the new version of the game’s files.
Ready or Not Modding Update Tips: https://voidinteractive.net/community-resources/
Q: ‘Why does an update download initially seem frustratingly large in data/gigabytes, even when the game doesn’t actually take up that much more storage when the download finishes’

> A: Game service platforms such as Steam etc. may update games by overwriting the game's files with the new files to replace it. For example, this means a update download that initially shows as 6GB during the download may actually only expand the game by 1GB in size, since it is largely just overwriting old game files for the other 5GB of data.
Q: ‘Why does an update take so long to download despite my fast internet’

> A: Other routine checks that a game service platform does to confirm game file integrity on the local storage device (e.g. your hard drive such as a HDD or SSD) during an update download can extend the perceived download size/time.
Q: ‘Why didn’t my game update yet on my console platform?'
> A: Console platforms do not necessarily support auto-updates, so you may have to trigger the update manually within your game library with an internet connection.
